I'll search for information about wakehealth.edu to help answer your question.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>wakehealth.edu Wake Forest Baptist Health</query>

Based on my search, **wakehealth.edu** is the official website for **Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist**, a major academic medical center and health system based in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. Here are the key details:

## Overview

- **Formerly known as:** Wake Forest Baptist Medical Center and Wake Forest Baptist Health
- **Parent organization:** Now part of **Atrium Health** (a Charlotte-based health system), following a merger/combination
- **Academic affiliation:** The health system serves as the clinical enterprise for **Wake Forest School of Medicine**, which is now part of **Wake Forest University** (the medical school moved with the university to Winston-Salem from the original Wake Forest, NC location in 1941)

## Key Components

| Feature | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **Medical Center** | 885-bed acute care hospital |
| **Level I Trauma Center** | One of only a few in North Carolina |
| **Comprehensive Cancer Center** | NCI-designated (National Cancer Institute) |
| **Children's Hospital** | Brenner Children's Hospital |
| **Research** | Extensive biomedical research enterprise |
| **Education** | Training for medical students, residents, and fellows |

## Historical Note

The branding has evolved over time:
- Originally "Wake Forest University Baptist Medical Center"
- Then "Wake Forest Baptist Health"
- Now "Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist" following the Atrium Health partnership

The website **wakehealth.edu** serves as the patient-facing and public information portal for appointments, finding doctors, locations, and health information, while academic and research functions may also have separate web presences.

---

Sources:
1. https://www.wakehealth.edu/
2. https://www.wakehealth.edu/about-us
3. https://www.atriumhealth.org/locations/atrium-health-wake-forest-baptist
